entries.title: Library calendar for airing anime and upcoming games
entries.description: See when new episodes of the anime you follow air and when the games in your library come out, all on one calendar. Click any item for its details.

entries.title: Get notified about new episodes and game releases
entries.description: Orbis now lets you know when a title in your library gets a new episode, a game comes out, or a release date changes.

entries.title: Choose which notifications you get
entries.description: A new notification settings page lets you turn each kind of notification on or off, and choose whether pop-up and desktop notifications show on this device.

entries.title: Sort Explore and see where your friends are
entries.description: Sort communities in Explore by popular or newest, hide the ones you've joined, and find communities your friends are in that you haven't joined yet.

entries.title: Add a description and links when you create a community
entries.description: When you start a new community, you can now say what it's about and add its links right away.

entries.title: Open all comments from a comment preview
entries.description: Clicking a comment in a post's preview now opens the full comments, so you can read the whole conversation.
